items.doc: David N. Baker SI-NEA oral history (2)
items.title: David N. Baker — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I had even made an album called – an all-star album with the trumpet teacher from . . .

ctx.x: No. It was just a quartet. We added those people.

But before that, in 1959, before we went up to Lenox, we had won the Notre Dame Jazz Festival. We took – I took my big band up there that had David Young and all those guys in it, and we did the Notre Dame Jazz Festival. I think we were [named] the best overall group or the best big band there or whatever. This was where you saw the beginning of the Paul Winter Consort, because all these guys were up there. George knew these people from having heard the tape of my band, so when he got ready to put the group…
